entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane into which the hordes of Phyrexia begin pouring in the Invasion.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: Source of the hordes that invade Dominaria.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Planeswalker and master artificer to whom the world looks for defense; gathers heroes, renegades, common folk and artifacts.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Leader of the Phyrexians, opposed by the coalition.

entities.name: The Coalition
entities.description: Cooperative effort of Dominarian forces from all five colors banded together against Yawgmoth and the Phyrexians.

entities.name: The Weatherlight
entities.description: Skyship whose crew appears on legendary cards.

events.summary: The hordes of Phyrexia begin pouring into Dominaria, and the world looks to Urza for defense; Urza gathers heroes, renegades, common folk and artifacts to fight.
events.quote: Urza gathers heroes, renegades, common folk, and powerful artifacts to fight the invasion.

relations.note: Banded together to oppose Yawgmoth and the Phyrexians
relations.quote: banded together to oppose Yawgmoth and the Phyrexians
